name: thriftos-v3
description: ThriftOS V3 - Industrial-grade ERP for textile recycling businesses

scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/db-guard.js "prisma migrate dev" && prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:prod: node scripts/db-guard.js "prisma migrate deploy" && prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:push: node scripts/db-guard.js "prisma db push" && prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/db-guard.js "prisma db seed" && prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/db-guard.js "prisma migrate reset" && prisma migrate reset
